user.title: Dusky Lights
user.description: Choose the lights that should follow the sun.

release.name: Release to the curve
release.description: Drop manual holds so lights return to the sun-following curve.

entity_id.name: Lights
entity_id.description: Lights to release; all if empty.

demo.name: Demo
demo.description: Run a virtual day of the real sun on one light.

entity_id.name: Light
entity_id.description: The single light to run the demo on.

seconds.name: Cycle length
seconds.description: Real seconds for one dusk-and-dawn cycle. 0 picks the shortest cycle with steps of 1 % or less.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day whose sun path to use. Defaults to today.

demo_stop.name: Stop demo
demo_stop.description: Stop the demo and return the light to the live sun.

clear_override.name: Use default
clear_override.description: Put a per-light setting back to following the global value.
